title: India readies for second cyclone in less than a week

blocks.text: NEW DELHI — A second cyclone in less than a week headed for India’s eastern coast on Monday, with the storm expected to hit overnight, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said. Cyclone Murasu is expected to make landfall around midnight on Monday or in the early hours of Tuesday, bringing heavy rain to Andhra Pradesh
